periodic4.description: Scans the environment every four navigation steps after the initial scan, subject to the paid observation budget. Between scans, the robot navigates using its stored spatial memory.

periodic5.description: Uses a fixed five-step scan cadence rather than four, reducing observation frequency without changing the navigation or safety system.

age4.description: Requests a scan when enough previously observed nearby cells have become stale, using a four-step age threshold and the frozen Age scheduler.

age5.description: Uses the Age scheduler with a five-step staleness threshold, allowing remembered cells to remain unobserved longer before requesting a scan.

age6.description: Uses a six-step staleness threshold in the Age scheduler to reduce the frequency of paid observations.

age_route_rescue.description: Extends view-aware Age scheduling with a route-aware rescue rule. Public memory and the nominal route help determine whether a scan should be requested despite the directional veto.

age_route_clock.description: A route-aware Age variant that uses directional staleness and route information to decide when the observation clock should request a scan.

rdao_v2.description: Compares current and next nominal viewpoints using public spatial memory. It may defer a scan when the next safe planned pose is predicted to provide materially better visibility of decision-relevant cells.

rdao_v21.description: Extends RDAO v2 by weighting current-view visibility with angular cell coverage, reducing the score of partially visible cells near the field-of-view edge.

caa_fast.description: Change-Aware Age shortens the observation deadline for cells classified as changing using authorized past observations. Other cells retain the baseline deadline.

caa_full.description: Change-Aware Age uses both shorter deadlines for changing cells and longer deadlines for stable cells. Classification uses observation history without altering occupancy memory.

raa_defer.description: Route-Adaptive Age starts from Age-5 and permits a bounded one-decision deferral using public route and viewpoint information.

uncertainty.description: Schedules observations using uncertainty estimated from observation history rather than a fixed interval. It uses the frozen uncertainty parameters and the same navigation safety system.

static.description: Takes only the initial paid observation and then navigates using the retained spatial memory. The independent emergency safety system remains active.

age_gap4.description: Adds a minimum four-step gap between paid scans to the frozen Age-4 scheduler.

age_motion.description: Combines Age-4 with motion and viewpoint history. A scan may be deferred based on movement or heading changes, subject to a deadline.

age_view_veto.description: Retains the original Age trigger but vetoes some requests when too little visible memory is stale. The original Age request is retained after the bounded fallback interval.

age_view_clock.description: Replaces the omnidirectional Age staleness fraction with a directional visible-cell fraction, while retaining the bounded fallback interval.

periodic_event.description: Combines periodic observation with event-triggered scan requests, requiring at least two steps since any scan and three since an event scan.

age_event.description: Combines Age observation with event-triggered scan requests, using the same two-step general and three-step event cooldowns.

rdao_v1.description: Route-Decision-Aware Observation estimates how uncertain regions could affect navigation using free/occupied route counterfactuals in the public spatial-memory map.

rdao_v1_footprint.description: Uses RDAO v1 with a footprint-based visibility predictor rather than the original visibility approximation, preserving the frozen route-decision scoring and scan budget.

rdao_v1_gate_first.description: Adds the frozen online observation gate to RDAO v1, allowing at most one override of its scan decision per episode.

rdao_v1_gate_every.description: Applies the RDAO v1 online gate whenever eligible during the episode rather than limiting it to the first override.

rdao_v22.description: Discounts partially visible current-view candidates only when observing them cannot change the immediate action or reachability. It preserves the full RDAO v2 score for decision-critical candidates.

b_age.description: Combines persistence-aware spatial memory with Age observation scheduling. Expected information value is disabled; this is the corrected B+Age configuration.

c_ternary.description: Uses expected information value to decide when to observe, while retaining ternary spatial memory rather than persistence-aware occupancy belief.

bc.description: Combines persistence-aware spatial memory (B) with expected-information-value observation scheduling (C).

c0_audit.description: The original information-value observation policy used as an audit baseline for candidate-selection extensions.

c_k.description: Evaluates expected information value using an uncertainty-ranked set of five observation candidates.

c_topology3d.description: The authorized topology-aware expected-information-value variant, using three selected candidates in the C-v2d configuration.

ms_k.description: Multi-step expected information value considers a three-step horizon and five uncertainty-ranked candidates.

ms_k_visibility.description: Uses three-step expected information value and a five-candidate visibility-based selector.

ms_topology.description: Uses multi-step expected information value with a three-step horizon and a topology-based candidate selector.

ms_topology_visibility.description: Combines a three-step expected-information-value horizon with topology and visibility-based candidate selection.

h1_k.description: One-step expected-information-value depth control with five candidates, used to isolate the effect of prediction horizon.

h3_k.description: Three-step expected-information-value depth control with five candidates, matched against H1-K.

h1_topology.description: One-step expected-information-value depth control using a topology-based candidate selector.

h3_topology.description: Three-step expected-information-value depth control using a topology-based candidate selector.

caa_slow.description: Change-Aware Age extends observation deadlines for stable cells while retaining the baseline deadline for other cells.

dao_veto.description: Discovery-aware observation uses estimated discoverable cells to veto some Age scan requests, while preserving its frozen verification and fallback rules.

dao_trigger.description: Discovery-aware observation uses the frozen trigger mode to request scans based on estimated discovery opportunities.

dao_route.description: Discovery-aware observation uses the public nominal route in its observation decision, without access to hidden environment geometry.

dao_combined.description: Combines the frozen discovery-aware trigger, veto and route-related observation logic in the DAO combined mode.

dao_veto_q50.description: A DAO-Veto estimator variant that attenuates predicted discovery beyond uncertain cells using a discovery factor of 0.5.

dao_veto_q80.description: A DAO-Veto estimator variant that attenuates predicted discovery using a discovery factor of 0.8.

dao_veto_optimistic.description: A DAO-Veto estimator control with discovery factor 1.0, preserving the optimistic estimate without attenuation.

dao_veto_route_gate.description: Applies a public-route gate to the DAO-Veto discovery logic when a nominal route is available.

dao_veto_deadline.description: Uses the DAO-Veto deadline variant with a bounded fallback conditioned on the public route.

dao_veto_joint.description: Combines the route gate and deadline variants of DAO-Veto.

deadline_stable.description: A history-gated DAO-Deadline variant that uses a stable public route prefix to permit later observation.

deadline_stable_quiet.description: Adds a previous-no-change condition to the stable-prefix history gate of DAO-Deadline.

raa_advance.description: Route-Adaptive Age starts from Age-5 and permits a bounded advance toward the Age-4 observation decision using public route information.

raa_joint.description: Combines Route-Adaptive Age's bounded Age-4 advance and one-decision deferral around the Age-5 parent policy.
